chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Mamie Smart before she became Mamie Smith
summary: Mamie Smart sang with the Troubadours in St. Louis and went East before her Crazy Blues hit.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Oh, Mamie Smith only she was Mamie Smart, you said, right?
Yeah, her name was Mamie Smart.
She was working in what? South Bend?

No, she was in St. Louis. She was...you know, joined Bill Bailey's Troubadours, and when that broke up, she went on East, and next time I heard from her--Mamie Smith, and she was a hit on this record 'Crazy Blues.'
Was she singing the same way when you worked with her in...
Yeah, she was a singer in the...
So it was, uh, what? She and, you and your brother did your act, and what else was part of the show?
Well, I told you they had a regular little olio and opening and everything--just a regular musical. you know.
